# Luca AI Product Documentation · Version 1 review draft

> Documents confirmed capabilities of Luca AI, the AI analyst for e-commerce brands. Review draft; noindex.

- [Luca AI product documentation](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/): Luca AI product documentation: the AI analyst for e-commerce brands. Confirmed capabilities, integrations, security, pricing model and onboarding.
- [Products](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/): Products. This section describes the parts of Luca and how they fit together. It is for buyers evaluating Luca and for operators who want to know what each.
- [Luca, the AI analyst agent](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/luca-agent/): Luca, the AI analyst agent: Natural-language questions let you ask about your business in everyday words and get an answer from your data, without writing.
- [Numbers: the reconciled control centre](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/numbers/): Numbers: the reconciled control centre: A reconciled database combines data from several systems and resolves differences between them, so each figure has.
- [Knowledge base and business context](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/knowledge-base/): Knowledge base and business context: A knowledge base is a set of company documents that an AI system can refer to when answering questions.
- [Capital, and how it relates to Luca](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/capital/): Capital, and how it relates to Luca: Optional capital means funding is an extra that a business may choose to explore, not something the product depends on.
- [Feature directory](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/features/): Feature directory. The feature directory groups Luca's supporting capabilities by area. It is for buyers checking specific requirements, such as how sources.
- [Data connection and setup](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/features/data-connection/): Data connection and setup: OAuth connection lets you link a data source by signing in on that platform's own screen and approving the access it requests.
- [Control and safety: Luca reads, you decide](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/features/control-and-safety/): Control and safety: Luca reads, you decide: Approval by default means no change is made in a connected system unless a person has decided to make it.
- [Teams, seats and regions](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/products/features/teams-and-seats/): Teams, seats and regions: A seat is one named user's access to a product.
- [Integrations](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/): Integrations. This section describes the data sources you can connect to Luca and what each one contributes. It is for teams evaluating Luca and for anyone.
- [Commerce platforms](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/commerce/): Commerce platforms. This page covers the commerce platforms you can connect to Luca. It is for brands that sell through their own store, through a.
- [Shopify](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/commerce/shopify/): Shopify: A connection that brings data from a Shopify store into Luca. It is one of the sources Luca recommends connecting first.
- [Amazon](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/commerce/amazon/): Amazon: A connection that brings Amazon selling data into Luca. Luca's website names it, with Shopify, as a starting source.
- [Advertising](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/advertising/): Advertising. This page covers the advertising platforms you can connect to Luca. It is for teams that want to look at ad activity alongside sales and.
- [Meta Ads](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/advertising/meta-ads/): Meta Ads: A connection that brings Meta / Facebook Ads data into Luca as an advertising source.
- [Google Ads](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/advertising/google-ads/): Google Ads: A read-only connection that brings Google Ads data into Luca as an advertising source.
- [Web analytics and search](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/analytics/): Web analytics and search. This page covers the web analytics and search sources you can connect to Luca. It is for teams that want site and search data.
- [Google Analytics 4](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/analytics/google-analytics-4/): Google Analytics 4: A connection that brings Google Analytics data into Luca as a web analytics source.
- [Google Search Console](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/analytics/google-search-console/): Google Search Console: A read-only connection that brings Google Search Console data into Luca.
- [Payments and accounting](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/finance/): Payments and accounting. This page covers the payments and accounting sources you can connect to Luca. It is for finance leads and founders who want sales.
- [Stripe](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/finance/stripe/): Stripe: A connection that brings Stripe payments data into Luca as a finance source.
- [Xero](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/finance/xero/): Xero: A connection that brings Xero accounting data into Luca as a finance source.
- [QuickBooks](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/finance/quickbooks/): QuickBooks: A connection to QuickBooks accounting data, described by Luca's founder as part of Luca's accounting connection.
- [Recharge (subscriptions)](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/subscriptions/recharge/): Recharge (subscriptions): Recharge subscription data connected by Luca's team and reconciled with store and accounting data as part of a Numbers build.
- [Subscriptions](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/subscriptions/): Subscriptions. This page covers subscription data in Luca. It is for brands that sell subscriptions and need that data to line up with store and accounting.
- [Workspace and documents](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/workspace/): Workspace and documents. This page covers the ways you can work with Luca from your workspace and give it extra context. It is for teams that want to ask.
- [Slack](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/workspace/slack/): Slack: A Slack app that lets you work with Luca from your Slack workspace.
- [Documents and files](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/workspace/documents/): Documents and files: The ability to add company documents to Luca so it has extra context when answering questions.
- [Custom connectors and ERPs](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/integrations/custom/): Custom connectors and ERPs: API connections that Luca's team builds on request for systems without a standard connector, such as a custom ERP.
- [Solutions by buyer](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/): Solutions by buyer. This section describes Luca from the point of view of specific buyers: founders and CEOs, subscription brands, finance leads, growth.
- [For founders and CEOs of Shopify brands](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/founders/): For founders and CEOs of Shopify brands: A single view that brings a brand's data together so the business can be read in one place. In Luca, this view is.
- [For subscription DTC brands](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/subscription-brands/): For subscription DTC brands: Bringing subscription platform, store and accounting data into agreement so that one view of the business can be trusted.
- [For CFOs and finance leads](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/finance-leads/): For CFOs and finance leads: Assurance that a tool cannot move funds or change financial systems without a person deciding to do so.
- [For growth and marketing teams](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/growth-teams/): For growth and marketing teams: Using an analysis tool from inside Slack, so a team can ask questions where it already works.
- [For Shopify and Amazon sellers](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/shopify-and-amazon-sellers/): For Shopify and Amazon sellers: Bringing sales from Shopify and Amazon into one profit and loss view of the business.
- [For European and UK brands](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/european-brands/): For European and UK brands: Publishing prices in a buyer's local currency, so European and UK brands can compare plans without conversion.
- [For Mastercard Business Bonus merchants](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/solutions/mastercard-business-bonus/): For Mastercard Business Bonus merchants: Partner pricing is a separate price list offered to members of a partner programme. For Luca, it is a dedicated.
- [Pricing model](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/pricing/): Pricing model: Published pricing means plans and prices are shown publicly, so you can read them without talking to sales.
- [Trial and signup](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/pricing/trial-and-signup/): Trial and signup: Some products ask for payment details and a data connection when you create your account.
- [Security and data handling](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/security/): Security and data handling. This section explains where Luca stores your data, who processes it, what access Luca requests and what happens to your data.
- [How Luca stores and processes your data](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/security/data-handling/): How Luca stores and processes your data: Tenant isolation is the practice of storing each customer's data apart from other customers' data in a shared.
- [Access, scopes and deletion](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/security/access-and-scopes/): Access, scopes and deletion: Retention and deletion rules set out how long a vendor keeps your data and when it is removed after you stop using the service.
- [Onboarding, services and support](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/support/): Onboarding, services and support. This section explains how Luca's team helps you get set up and where you can learn from other users. It is for teams.
- [Onboarding: done with you](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/support/onboarding/): Onboarding: done with you: Hands-on onboarding means the vendor's team does much of the setup work with you, rather than leaving you to configure the.
- [Community and podcast](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/support/community/): Community and podcast: A customer community is a shared space where users and prospects exchange ideas about a product.
- [About Luca](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/about/): About Luca: Founder background describes the experience of the people leading a company.
- [Customers and proof](https://krishna-kaanth.github.io/luca-ai-product-docs/customers/): Customers and proof: Customer logos show which brands a vendor names as customers.
